import React from 'react'; import './Solution.css'; const Solution = () => { const primaryFeatures = [ { num: '01', title: 'Autonomous Inspection', desc: 'Automates inspection workflows and reduces dependence on conventional manual track walk methods.', icon: 'fa-robot' }, { num: '02', title: 'AI-Based Fault Detection', desc: 'Uses AI-driven computer vision to identify potential track faults, alignment shifts, and structural abnormalities.', icon: 'fa-microchip' }, { num: '03', title: 'Real-Time Monitoring', desc: 'Processes inspection information directly onboard to support timely detection and immediate alert dispatch.', icon: 'fa-bolt' }, { num: '04', title: 'Intelligent Reporting', desc: 'Transforms raw observations into structured digital logs and visual spatial intelligence for operational units.', icon: 'fa-chart-line' }, { num: '05', title: 'Predictive Maintenance', desc: 'Supports a proactive shift from reactive track inspection toward data-driven scheduled maintenance planning.', icon: 'fa-shield-alt' }, { num: '06', title: 'Security-Oriented Design', desc: 'Includes theft-proof and safety-focused physical features as part of the overall solution engineering concept.', icon: 'fa-lock' } ]; const pipelineSteps = [ 'INFRASTRUCTURE', 'ROBOTIC INSPECTION', 'SENSING & DATA COLLECTION', 'AI / COMPUTER VISION', 'FAULT DETECTION', 'REAL-TIME ANALYSIS', 'REPORTING & ALERTS', 'PREDICTIVE MAINTENANCE', 'SAFER OPERATIONS' ]; const industryApplications = [ { title: 'Railways', desc: 'AI-powered track inspection and intelligent railway safety monitoring systems.', icon: 'fa-train', tag: 'Core Focus' }, { title: 'Industrial Infrastructure', desc: 'Automated inspection support for difficult-to-access high-rise structural assets.', icon: 'fa-building', tag: 'Asset Safety' }, { title: 'Heavy Industry', desc: 'Robotic inspection support for industrial plants and hazardous operating environments.', icon: 'fa-industry', tag: 'Plant Operations' }, { title: 'Maritime / Shipyards', desc: 'AI-assisted inspection concepts for ship hulls, docks, and marine structural components.', icon: 'fa-ship', tag: 'Maritime Concept' }, { title: 'Critical Infrastructure', desc: 'Data-driven inspection intelligence for physical assets requiring continuous monitoring.', icon: 'fa-shield-virus', tag: 'Infrastructure' } ]; const techStack = [ { category: 'Robotics', items: ['Autonomous Robotic Platforms', 'Robot Control Systems'], icon: 'fa-robot' }, { category: 'Perception', items: ['High-Res Cameras', 'LiDAR Sensors', 'Optional Thermal Sensing'], icon: 'fa-eye' }, { category: 'Artificial Intelligence', items: ['Computer Vision', 'YOLO Object Detection', 'Edge AI Acceleration'], icon: 'fa-brain' }, { category: 'Navigation', items: ['SLAM Mapping', 'Autonomous Pathing'], icon: 'fa-compass' }, { category: 'Software Stack', items: ['Python Architecture', 'ROS Integration', 'Mavlink Communication'], icon: 'fa-code' }, { category: 'Data & Intelligence', items: ['Real-Time Analysis', 'Digital Reporting', 'Predictive Maintenance Insights'], icon: 'fa-database' } ]; return (
